# Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks that were run.

## Risks

Describe compatibility, real-time, state-restoration, security, and licensing risks. Write `None identified` only after checking them.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no generated build output.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Debug and Release checks were run, or omissions are explained.
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog are current.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or copyrighted lyrics were added.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and include a DCO sign-off.
